_comment: Placeholder assembly-point data bundled with the app. Section 5.3's REST API has no endpoint for evacuation routes or assembly points, even though Section 6.4 requires caching them offline — flagged in docs/nexus-log.md. Bundling as a static asset satisfies 'useful with no connection' for the prototype/demo; a real deployment needs an authority-managed data source and a backend endpoint to serve it.
